mapper.select: SELECT c.slug, c.label, c.sort_order, COUNT(t.id) AS template_count FROM template_category c LEFT JOIN creation_template t ON t.category_slug = c.slug GROUP BY c.slug, c.label, c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order
mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.category_slug, c.label AS category_label, t.description, t.cover_url, t.target_result_url, t.required_image_count, t.accepted_mime_types, t.max_file_size_bytes, t.featured, t.sort_order, t.created_at FROM creation_template t JOIN template_category c ON c.slug = t.category_slug
mapper.select: WHERE t.featured = TRUE ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
WHERE t.category_slug = #{category} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
